label: Domino's UK Nutrition Guide (nutrition_pizzas)
basis: whole pizza (per whole pizza, by size/crust); some rows per serving
notes: Official Domino's UK CDN (dominos.a.bigcontent.io). Requires fetch_protected (Cloudflare 403s plain requests). generic_pdf.parse_pdf yields 201 rows of which 87 have a real product name; the rest have a numeric first cell (multi-row name wrapping) and need a name-carry-forward fix. Values are whole-pizza (e.g. Absolute Banger 2512 kcal / 114.4g protein). Sibling static paths may exist for sides/desserts - not yet enumerated.
